method: Continuous steady Graetz PDE. Analytic Poiseuille-weighted cosine mass matrix, independent Gauss inlet projection, symmetric generalized eigendecomposition, exact x exponential and analytic x/y cell integrals. No JS finite-volume operator reused.
scope: Neumann wall-flux corner at x=0 is singular. Uniform inlet is imposed in velocity-weighted L2; no pointwise wall-gradient match at the inlet corner is claimed. Values use positive x or finite x-cell means. Stationary thermal entrance with prescribed developed velocity, not unsteady entrance momentum or transient PDE reference.

productionVerification.method: Actual JS production solver advanced to t=1 and t=2, then compared with independently computed continuous reference. Production results do not determine the spectral reference.

originalUnsupportedHypothesis.scope: Our provisional assumption, not an owner acceptance criterion. Rejected without altering the absolute error budgets. It ignores possible cancellation/mixing of different error contributions; no unique cause is established.

productionVerification.interpretation: The exact discrete stationary cross-section balance yields Tb_i=Tin+g*(i+1)*dx, whereas the continuous x-cell mean is Tin+g*(i+1/2)*dx. Bulk error g*dx/2 is verified separately. Overall field RMS orders are only observations, not a proof of asymptotic first order.
